senses.gloss:
उख उख, अस्, m. (fr. rt. खन् with उद् ?),
Ved. a boiler, a pot, a vessel; N. of a pupil of Tittiri;
(आ), f. a boiler, any saucepan, a pot or vessel which
can be put on the fire; a part of the body.
—उख-
च्छिद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. breaking the pot.

उखर्वल उखर्वल or उखल, अस्, m. a kind
of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
